title: Garlic Butter Pasta with Parmesan
teaser: A five-ingredient pantry pasta that tastes far fancier than the effort involved.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until just tender, then drain, keeping a mugful of the pasta water.
Melt the butter in the same pot over low heat and add the garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant, not browned.
Tip the pasta back in with a splash of the reserved water and toss well.
Stir in the parmesan until it melts into a light sauce, adding more water if it looks dry.
Season with salt and pepper and scatter parsley over the top.

title: One-Pan Tomato & Basil Pasta
teaser: The pasta cooks straight in the sauce, so there's only one pot to wash.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and soften the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, stock, and pasta, and stir well.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has absorbed (about 12-15 minutes).
Stir in most of the basil and season to taste.
Serve topped with parmesan and the remaining basil.

title: Creamy Chicken & Bacon Pasta
teaser: Chicken, bacon, and a light cream sauce — a firm favourite for a reason.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions.
Meanwhile, fry the bacon in a pan until starting to crisp, then add the chicken and cook until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute.
Pour in the cream, season, and simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Drain the pasta and toss through the sauce with a little parmesan.

title: Sausage & Pepper Pasta
teaser: Sausages, peppers, and a tomato sauce — hearty and simple.
steps: Squeeze the sausage meat out of the skins into small chunks and fry in a little oil until browned.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in the tomatoes and oregano, season, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to packet instructions and drain.
Toss the pasta through the sauce and serve.

title: Tuna & Sweetcorn Pasta Bake
teaser: A store-cupboard bake that kids and adults both tend to like.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Cook the pasta until just tender, then drain.
Mix the pasta with the tuna, sweetcorn, crème fraîche, and mustard in an ovenproof dish.
Top with the grated cheddar.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

title: Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes
teaser: About as fast as dinner gets — jarred pesto, pasta, and fresh tomatoes.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions and drain, keeping a splash of the water.
Return the pasta to the pot off the heat and stir in the pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Fold in the cherry tomatoes and rocket if using.
Serve with parmesan on top.

title: Simple Spaghetti Bolognese
teaser: The classic mince-and-tomato sauce that's always worth having in your back pocket.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the mince and cook, breaking it up, until browned all over.
Stir in the tomato purée, chopped tomatoes, and oregano, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti according to packet instructions and drain.
Toss the pasta through the sauce, or serve the sauce on top, with parmesan.

title: Creamy Salmon & Spinach Pasta
teaser: Pan-fried salmon flaked through a light cream and spinach sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions and drain.
Meanwhile, season the salmon and pan-fry skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip and cook for 2-3 minutes more until just cooked through. Flake into large chunks.
In the same pan, soften the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the cream and spinach and simmer until the spinach wilts.
Fold the pasta and flaked salmon through the sauce.
Season to taste and serve with parmesan.

title: Chipotle Beef & Pork Rigatoni
teaser: A smoky, chipotle-spiked mince and tomato sauce tossed through rigatoni, with wilted spinach and a peppery rocket topping.

ingredients.item: chipotle paste (use less for a milder version)

steps: Cook the rigatoni in salted boiling water until tender, then drain, drizzle with a little oil, and set aside.
In a dry frying pan over medium-high heat, fry the mince (and chorizo, if using) until browned all over, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the garlic and chipotle paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the passata, stock paste, sugar, and water, and simmer for 5-6 minutes until thickened.
Add the spinach a handful at a time until wilted.
Fold the drained pasta and most of the cheddar through the sauce, adding a splash of water if it's too thick.
Serve topped with the remaining cheddar, the rocket, and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Salmon & Lemon Pasta
teaser: A lighter salmon pasta with lemon, garlic, and a splash of cream.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions and drain.
Season the salmon and pan-fry for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through. Flake into chunks.
In the same pan, soften the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the cream, lemon zest, and juice.
Simmer for 1-2 minutes, then toss the pasta and flaked salmon through the sauce.
Season to taste and serve.

title: Beef Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
teaser: Simple homemade meatballs simmered in a tomato sauce, served over pasta.
steps: Mix the mince, egg, and breadcrumbs together and season well. Shape into small balls.
Fry the meatballs in a little oil until browned all over, then remove.
Add the garlic to the pan, then the tomatoes and oregano.
Return the meatballs to the sauce and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta, drain, and serve with the meatballs and sauce on top, finished with parmesan.

title: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
teaser: A simple, creamy parmesan sauce tossed with pasta and pan-fried chicken.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions and drain.
Season the chicken and pan-fry in a little butter until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, soften the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the cream and parmesan and stir until melted into a sauce.
Toss the pasta through the sauce.
Slice the chicken and serve on top.

title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
teaser: Prawns, lemon, and garlic tossed with pasta in a light, buttery sauce — ready before you've finished the washing up.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until just tender, then drain, keeping a mugful of the pasta water.
Heat the oil and butter in a large pan and fry the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the prawns and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink and just cooked through.
Stir in the lemon zest and juice, then toss in the drained pasta with a splash of the reserved water.
Season with salt and pepper and scatter parsley over the top.

title: Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry
teaser: A reliable, veg-forward stir-fry with a simple soy-garlic sauce.
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through, then set aside.
Add the broccoli to the pan with a splash of water, cover, and steam-fry for 3-4 minutes until just tender.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, add the soy sauce and honey, and toss.
Stir in the cornflour mixture and cook for 1 minute until the sauce thickens. Serve with rice.

title: Beef & Pepper Stir-Fry
teaser: Quick strips of beef with peppers in a glossy oyster sauce.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat and sear the beef quickly in batches until browned. Set aside.
Add the onion and peppers to the pan and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Return the beef to the pan along with the oyster sauce and soy sauce.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes and serve with rice or noodles.

title: Tofu & Vegetable Stir-Fry
teaser: Crispy tofu cubes with whatever vegetables you have to hand.

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cubed and patted dry

steps: Dust the tofu cubes lightly in cornflour and fry in oil until golden and crisp on most sides. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry the vegetables for 3-4 minutes until just tender.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Return the tofu to the pan, add the soy sauce and sesame oil, and toss to coat.
Serve over rice or noodles.

title: Sweet Chilli Prawn Stir-Fry
teaser: Prawns cook in minutes, making this one of the fastest dinners here.
steps: Heat oil in a pan over high heat and stir-fry the pepper for 2-3 minutes.
Add the garlic and prawns and cook for 2-3 minutes until the prawns turn pink and opaque.
Stir in the sweet chilli sauce and soy sauce and toss to coat.
Cook for 1 more minute, then garnish with spring onion and serve with rice.

title: Cashew Chicken Stir-Fry
teaser: A takeaway favourite you can put together with pantry staples and a bag of cashews.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
Add the pepper to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cashews and cook for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken to the pan, add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey, and toss to coat.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until glossy, then serve with rice.

title: Prawn Pad Thai Stir-Fry
teaser: A simplified, weeknight take on pad thai using flat rice noodles and a quick tangy sauce.
steps: Soak the rice noodles in boiling water according to packet instructions, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the prawns until pink, about 2-3 minutes. Set aside.
Push everything aside, pour in the beaten eggs, and scramble until just set.
Add the garlic, noodles, fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice, and toss to coat.
Return the prawns to the pan with the beansprouts, toss for 1 minute, and serve.

title: Thai Basil Beef Stir-Fry
teaser: A fragrant, fiery beef stir-fry built on Thai basil and chilli.

ingredients.item: Handful Thai basil leaves (or regular basil)

steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds.
Add the beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the red pepper and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the fish sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir through the basil leaves until just wilted. Serve with rice.

title: Egg Fried Rice
teaser: The best use for leftover rice — fast, cheap, and endlessly adaptable.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat, pour in the eggs, and scramble briefly. Remove and set aside.
Add a little more oil and stir-fry the frozen veg for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Return the egg to the pan along with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together, top with spring onion, and serve.

title: Chicken & Rice Bowl with Peanut Sauce
teaser: Grilled chicken and rice tied together with a quick peanut butter sauce.

ingredients.item: Splash of hot water to loosen

steps: Season the chicken and grill or pan-fry until cooked through, then slice.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, and honey together, adding hot water until pourable.
Serve the chicken over rice, drizzled with the peanut sauce.
Add sliced cucumber on the side.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
teaser: A sticky homemade teriyaki glaze over chicken and rice.
steps: Pan-fry the chicken in a little oil until cooked through and lightly browned.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and garlic in a small bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and simmer for 2-3 minutes until it thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds scattered on top.

title: Black Bean & Rice Burrito Bowl
teaser: A vegetarian bowl built from tinned staples and whatever fresh veg you have.
steps: Warm the black beans with the cumin in a small pan for 3-4 minutes.
Divide the rice between bowls.
Top with the beans, sweetcorn, tomatoes, and avocado.
Squeeze lime juice over everything before serving.

title: Chickpea & Spinach Curry Rice Bowl
teaser: A mild, quick curry that leans entirely on tinned and frozen basics.
steps: Heat oil in a pan and soften the onion for 4-5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and chickpeas.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, and serve over rice.

title: Chicken & Chorizo Rice
teaser: A one-pot Spanish-inspired rice dish with chicken and smoky chorizo.
steps: Fry the chorizo in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes until it releases its oil.
Add the chicken and onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the pepper, rice, and paprika.
Pour in the stock, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 18-20 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
teaser: A heartier take on egg fried rice with strips of chicken added in.
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok until cooked through, then set aside.
Push the chicken aside, pour in the eggs, and scramble briefly. Remove and set aside with the chicken.
Add the frozen veg and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Return the chicken and egg to the pan with the soy sauce, toss together, and top with spring onion.

title: Salmon Poke-Style Rice Bowl
teaser: A fresh, no-cook-required bowl if you use sushi-grade salmon, or lightly seared if you'd rather cook it through.

ingredients.item: fillets, cubed (sushi-grade if eating raw, or seared)

steps: If searing, cook the salmon cubes in a hot pan for 2-3 minutes until just cooked through. If using sushi-grade salmon, this step can be skipped.
Toss the salmon with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Divide the rice between bowls.
Top with the salmon, avocado, and cucumber.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve.

title: Chicken Fajita Rice Bowl
teaser: All the flavours of fajitas, served over rice instead of in a wrap.

ingredients.item: Soured cream and lime to serve

steps: Toss the chicken with the fajita seasoning.
Fry the chicken, pepper, and onion together in a little oil for 8-10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and everything is lightly charred.
Divide the rice between bowls.
Top with the chicken and vegetables, and finish with soured cream and a squeeze of lime.

title: Cajun Salmon Rice Bowl with Sweetcorn
teaser: Blackened cajun salmon over rice with sweetcorn and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Rub the salmon with the cajun seasoning.
Heat the oil in a pan and pan-fry the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and blackened at the edges.
Warm the sweetcorn in a small pan for 2-3 minutes.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the sweetcorn.
Flake the salmon over the top and finish with a squeeze of lime.

title: Prawn & Pineapple Fried Rice
teaser: A sweet-and-savoury fried rice that turns a tin of pineapple into dinner.
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the prawns for 2-3 minutes until pink. Set aside.
Pour the eggs into the pan and scramble briefly. Remove and set aside with the prawns.
Add the red pepper to the pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Return the prawns and egg to the pan with the pineapple, soy sauce, and curry powder if using.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes, garnish with spring onion, and serve.

title: Sticky Honey Soy Salmon Rice Bowl
teaser: Pan-fried salmon glazed in honey and soy, served over rice with a quick garnish.

ingredients.item: Sliced spring onion and sesame seeds to garnish

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan and pan-fry the salmon skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip and cook for 2-3 minutes more.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, and garlic together in a small bowl.
Pour the sauce over the salmon and let it bubble for 1-2 minutes, spooning it over the fillets until sticky.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the salmon and any sauce left in the pan.
Drizzle with sesame oil and scatter with spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
teaser: Everything roasts on one tray, so prep and cleanup both take minutes.

ingredients.item: fajita seasoning (or chilli powder, cumin, paprika)
Tortillas and soured cream to serve

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the chicken, peppers, and onion with the oil and seasoning on a baking tray.
Spread everything into a single layer and roast for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway, until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the tortillas and serve everything alongside soured cream.

title: Sheet-Pan Sausages & Roast Veg
teaser: Sausages and vegetables roast together for an almost effortless dinner.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the potatoes with half the oil and roast for 10 minutes to get a head start.
Add the sausages, onion, and courgette to the tray, drizzle with the rest of the oil and the herbs.
Roast for 25-30 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are browned and the veg is tender.

title: Honey Garlic Salmon with Broccoli
teaser: Salmon fillets glazed with honey and garlic, roasted alongside broccoli.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the broccoli with the olive oil and spread on a baking tray. Nestle the salmon among it.
Mix the honey, soy sauce, and garlic, and spoon over the salmon.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until the salmon is cooked through and the broccoli is tender.

title: Roasted Veg & Halloumi Tray Bake
teaser: A vegetarian tray bake where salty halloumi does most of the work.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the vegetables with the oil and paprika on a baking tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the halloumi slices and cherry tomatoes to the tray.
Roast for a further 10 minutes until the halloumi is golden and the veg is soft.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken Thighs & Potatoes
teaser: Skin-on chicken thighs roast with baby potatoes for a Sunday-dinner feel on a weeknight.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the potatoes with half the oil and season, and spread on a baking tray.
Rub the chicken thighs with the remaining oil, herbs, salt, and pepper, and place among the potatoes with the lemon slices.
Roast for 35-40 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is crisp.

title: Mince & Potato Hash
teaser: A one-pan skillet hash of mince, potatoes, and onion that needs almost no watching.

ingredients.item: Fried or poached egg to top (optional)

steps: Parboil the diced potatoes for 5 minutes, then drain well.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the potatoes until golden, about 8-10 minutes.
Push the potatoes to one side, add the mince and onion, and cook until the mince is browned.
Stir everything together with the paprika and season to taste.
Top with a fried or poached egg if you like.

title: Honey Mustard Salmon Tray Bake
teaser: Salmon glazed with honey and mustard, roasted alongside potatoes and greens.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the potatoes with the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Mix the honey and mustard together.
Add the salmon and green beans to the tray and brush the salmon with the honey mustard mix.
Roast for a further 10-12 minutes until the salmon is cooked through.

title: Salmon & Asparagus Sheet Pan
teaser: A quick, light dinner that roasts in one tray with minimal washing up.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the asparagus with half the oil and spread on a baking tray.
Nestle the salmon among the asparagus and top with the garlic and lemon slices.
Drizzle with the remaining oil and season.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until the salmon is cooked through.

title: Sticky Chicken Drumsticks with Sweet Potato Wedges
teaser: Honey-glazed drumsticks and sweet potato wedges roast together on one tray.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the sweet potato wedges with the olive oil and a pinch of salt, and spread on a baking tray.
Mix the honey, soy sauce, and garlic, and brush over the drumsticks.
Add the drumsticks to the tray among the wedges.
Roast for 35-40 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is sticky and golden.

title: Miso Salmon with Sesame Greens
teaser: Salmon glazed with miso, roasted alongside quick sesame greens.

ingredients.item: pak choi (or a bag of greens)

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Mix the miso, honey, and soy sauce, and brush over the salmon.
Place the salmon on a baking tray and roast for 10-12 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile, steam or stir-fry the greens with the sesame oil for 3-4 minutes until just wilted.
Serve the salmon over the greens, scattered with sesame seeds.

title: Moroccan Spiced Chicken & Chickpea Traybake
teaser: Warmly spiced chicken thighs roast with chickpeas and red onion for a fuss-free dinner.

ingredients.item: ras el hanout (or cumin, paprika, and cinnamon mixed)

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the chickpeas and red onion with half the oil and spread on a baking tray.
Rub the chicken thighs with the remaining oil and the spice mix, season with salt and pepper, and place among the chickpeas with the lemon slices.
Roast for 35-40 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is golden.

title: Tomato & Lentil Soup
teaser: A filling, budget-friendly soup that mostly looks after itself on the stove.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion and garlic for 4-5 minutes.
Add the cumin, tomatoes, lentils, and stock.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft.
Blend if you'd like it smooth, or leave as is. Season to taste and serve with bread.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
teaser: A comforting classic that comes together with shop-bought stock and leftover or quick-cooked chicken.

ingredients.item: cooked chicken, shredded (or 1 raw breast, sliced thin)

steps: Bring the stock to a simmer in a large pot.
Add the carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken (raw or cooked) and thyme, and simmer for 8-10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the noodles for the last 3-4 minutes of cooking, until tender. Season and serve.

title: Creamy Broccoli & Potato Soup
teaser: Blended into velvety smoothness — good for using up an ageing head of broccoli.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the potatoes and stock, bring to a simmer, and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the broccoli and cook for a further 8-10 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream if using, and season to taste.

title: Spiced Carrot & Ginger Soup
teaser: Naturally sweet and warming, with just a handful of ingredients.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion and ginger for 4-5 minutes.
Add the carrots, coriander, and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the carrots are soft.
Blend until smooth and season to taste.

title: Chicken & Sweetcorn Chowder
teaser: A creamy, filling soup that's closer to a stew — good on a cold evening.
steps: Fry the onion in a little oil for 4 minutes.
Add the chicken and potatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Pour in the stock, bring to a simmer, and cook for 15 minutes until the potatoes and chicken are cooked through.
Stir in the sweetcorn and cream, warm through, and season to taste.

title: Leek & Potato Soup
teaser: A classic, gently flavoured soup that blends into something silky with barely any effort.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion and leeks for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and stock, bring to a simmer, and cook for 15-18 minutes until the potatoes are soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream if using, and season to taste.
Serve with crusty bread.

title: Spicy Black Bean Soup
teaser: A store-cupboard soup that gets its kick from chilli and smoked paprika.

ingredients.item: Lime juice and chopped coriander to serve

steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion and garlic for 4-5 minutes.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, and chilli powder, and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the black beans and stock, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend partially for a thicker texture if you like, and season to taste.
Serve with a squeeze of lime and chopped coriander.

title: Roasted Red Pepper & Tomato Soup
teaser: Roasted peppers and tomatoes blended into a smoky, comforting soup.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Roast the peppers, cut-side down, with a drizzle of oil for 20 minutes until softened and lightly charred. Roughly chop.
Meanwhile, soften the onion and garlic in a pot for 4-5 minutes.
Add the roasted peppers, tomatoes, smoked paprika, and stock.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes, then blend until smooth. Season to taste.

title: Fried Egg & Avocado Toast
teaser: Breakfast food is fair game for dinner, and this one takes ten minutes.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with a little salt, pepper, and olive oil, and spread onto the toast.
Fry the eggs to your liking in a little oil.
Top the toast with the eggs and a pinch of chilli flakes if you like.

title: Cheesy Baked Beans on Toast
teaser: About as low-effort as dinner can get, and genuinely satisfying.
steps: Warm the baked beans in a small pan over medium heat.
Toast and butter the bread.
Pile the beans onto the toast.
Top with grated cheddar and grill for 1-2 minutes if you'd like it melted, or serve as is.

title: Veggie Omelette
teaser: A flexible way to use up whatever vegetables are left in the fridge.

ingredients.item: Handful spinach or mixed vegetables, chopped small

steps: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat and add the vegetables, cooking for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Pour in the eggs and let them set around the edges, then gently push the cooked edges towards the centre.
Sprinkle the cheese over one half, fold the omelette over, and slide onto a plate.

title: Halloumi Wrap with Sweet Chilli
teaser: Fried halloumi, salad, and sweet chilli sauce rolled into a wrap.
steps: Fry the halloumi slices in a little oil until golden on both sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Warm the tortillas briefly if you like.
Layer the lettuce and halloumi onto the wraps.
Drizzle with sweet chilli sauce, roll up, and serve.

title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
teaser: A lunch-counter classic that works just as well for dinner.

ingredients.item: chicken breast, sliced (or leftover roast chicken)
Handful romaine or cos lettuce, shredded

steps: Toss the lettuce with the caesar dressing and parmesan.
Lay the chicken over each wrap.
Top with the dressed lettuce.
Roll up tightly and slice in half to serve.

title: Falafel Wrap with Hummus
teaser: Shop-bought falafel and hummus make this a five-minute assembly job.
steps: Warm the falafel according to packet instructions.
Spread hummus over the wraps.
Layer in the lettuce, cucumber, tomato, and falafel.
Roll up and serve, or wrap in foil to eat on the go.

title: BLT Sandwich
teaser: Bacon, lettuce, and tomato — a sandwich that never needs improving.
steps: Fry or grill the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread if you like.
Spread mayonnaise on the bread.
Layer the bacon, lettuce, and tomato, then close the sandwich and slice in half.

title: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
teaser: Spiced chicken strips with a garlic yoghurt sauce, rolled into a warm wrap.

ingredients.item: shawarma or mixed spice (cumin, paprika, turmeric)

steps: Toss the chicken with the spices and a little oil.
Fry in a hot pan for 6-8 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
Mix the yoghurt with the garlic to make a quick sauce.
Warm the tortillas and layer with lettuce, tomato, and chicken.
Drizzle with the yoghurt sauce, roll up, and serve.

title: BBQ Chicken Wraps
teaser: Shredded or sliced chicken tossed in barbecue sauce and rolled into a wrap.

ingredients.item: chicken breast, shredded (or leftover roast chicken)

steps: Toss the shredded chicken with the barbecue sauce.
Warm the tortillas briefly if you like.
Layer the lettuce, chicken, and cheese onto the wraps.
Roll up tightly and slice in half to serve.

title: Sloppy Joe Rolls
teaser: A messy, saucy mince filling piled into soft bread rolls.
steps: Fry the onion in a little oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, and mustard.
Simmer for 12-15 minutes until thickened.
Split the rolls and pile the mince mixture inside.

title: Greek Chicken Pitta Wrap
teaser: Grilled chicken, tzatziki, and salad rolled into a warm pitta.

ingredients.item: tzatziki (or yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber and garlic)
Few slices tomato and red onion

steps: Toss the chicken with the oregano and a little oil.
Fry in a hot pan for 6-8 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
Warm the pittas.
Layer the lettuce, tomato, onion, and chicken into the pittas.
Drizzle with tzatziki, roll or fold, and serve.

title: Crispy Chicken Wrap with Sriracha Mayo
teaser: Golden pan-fried chicken strips with a spicy mayo, rolled up with crunchy lettuce.
steps: Coat the chicken strips in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in a little oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise and sriracha together.
Warm the tortillas, then spread with the sriracha mayo and layer with lettuce and chicken.
Roll up tightly and slice in half to serve.

title: Greek-Style Salad with Feta
teaser: A fresh, no-cook option for a hot evening.
steps: Combine the cucumber, tomatoes, and onion in a large bowl.
Scatter the feta and olives over the top.
Whisk the olive oil and vinegar together and drizzle over the salad.
Toss gently and serve with warm pitta or bread.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
teaser: A heartier, main-course version of the classic side salad.
steps: Season the chicken and pan-fry or grill until cooked through, then slice.
Toss the lettuce with the caesar dressing in a large bowl.
Top with the sliced chicken, parmesan, and croutons.
Serve immediately while the croutons are still crisp.

title: Warm Potato & Bacon Salad
teaser: New potatoes and crispy bacon in a light mustard dressing, best served warm.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes, then drain.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Whisk the mustard, oil, and vinegar together.
Toss the warm potatoes with the bacon, spring onions, and dressing.

title: Salmon & New Potato Salad
teaser: Warm new potatoes, flaked salmon, and a light mustard dressing.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 12-15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Meanwhile, season the salmon and pan-fry or grill for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through. Flake into chunks.
Whisk the mustard, olive oil, and lemon juice together.
Toss the warm potatoes and beans with the dressing.
Top with the flaked salmon and serve.

title: Chicken Caesar Pasta Salad
teaser: A pasta twist on the classic Caesar, good served warm or chilled.
steps: Cook the pasta according to packet instructions, drain, and cool slightly.
Toss the pasta with the caesar dressing.
Fold in the lettuce, chicken, and parmesan.
Top with croutons just before serving.

title: Beef Tacos
teaser: Mince and a simple spice mix, spooned into tortillas with your favourite toppings.

ingredients.item: Lettuce, cheese, and salsa to serve

steps: Fry the onion in a little oil for 3-4 minutes until soft.
Add the beef mince and spices and cook, breaking it up, until browned through.
Warm the tortillas or taco shells.
Fill with the mince and top with lettuce, cheese, and salsa.

title: Bean & Cheese Quesadillas
teaser: A crisp, cheesy vegetarian option that's ready in one pan.

ingredients.item: black beans or kidney beans, drained and mashed lightly
Salsa and soured cream to serve

steps: Mix the mashed beans with the cumin.
Spread the bean mixture and cheese over half of each tortilla, then fold over.
Dry-fry each quesadilla in a pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Slice into wedges and serve with salsa and soured cream.

title: Simple Chilli Con Carne
teaser: A weeknight-sized batch of chilli that also reheats well the next day.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4 minutes.
Add the beef mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the chilli powder and cumin, then add the tomatoes and kidney beans.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Serve over rice.

title: Beef Mince Nachos
teaser: A tray of nachos loaded with spiced mince and melted cheese, ready to share.

ingredients.item: Salsa and soured cream to serve

steps: Fry the mince with the cumin and paprika until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C) or use the grill.
Spread the tortilla chips on a baking tray and scatter over the mince.
Top with the grated cheddar and jalapeños if using.
Bake or grill for 5-8 minutes until the cheese has melted. Serve with salsa and soured cream.

title: Blackened Salmon Tacos
teaser: Spiced salmon and a quick lime slaw, piled into warm tortillas.
steps: Rub the salmon with the blackening seasoning.
Heat the oil in a pan and pan-fry the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through and blackened at the edges. Flake into chunks.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and soured cream to make a quick slaw.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the salmon and slaw and serve.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
teaser: Shredded chicken rolled in tortillas, smothered in a smoky tomato sauce, and baked with cheese.

ingredients.item: cooked chicken, shredded (or 2 chicken breasts, cooked and shredded)

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4 minutes, then add the tomatoes and chipotle paste or paprika. Simmer for 8-10 minutes to make the sauce.
Mix a few spoonfuls of the sauce through the shredded chicken.
Divide the chicken between the tortillas, roll up, and place in an ovenproof dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top, scatter with cheese, and bake for 15-20 minutes until bubbling.

title: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Tacos
teaser: Roasted sweet potato and black beans spiced and piled into tortillas — a hearty vegetarian taco night.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Toss the sweet potato with a little oil, cumin, and smoked paprika, then roast for 20-25 minutes until tender, stirring halfway.
Warm the black beans in a small pan for a few minutes.
Mix the lime juice through the soured cream.
Warm the tortillas, then fill with the sweet potato and black beans.
Drizzle with the lime crema and scatter with coriander.

title: Shrimp Tacos with Mango Salsa
teaser: Quick-fried shrimp with a fresh mango salsa — light, bright, and ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Toss the shrimp with the chilli powder and cumin.
Mix the mango, red onion, and half the lime juice together to make the salsa.
Heat a little oil in a pan and cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the shrimp and top with the mango salsa and remaining lime juice.

title: Sausage & Bean Casserole
teaser: Sausages simmered with beans in a tomato sauce — a filling one-pot dinner.

ingredients.item: butter beans or cannellini beans, drained

steps: Brown the sausages in a little oil in a large pan, then remove and set aside.
Add the onion to the pan and soften for 4 minutes.
Return the sausages to the pan with the tomatoes, beans, and herbs.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until the sausages are cooked through and the sauce has thickened. Serve with crusty bread or mash.

title: Beef Mince & Butter Bean Stew
teaser: A simple, filling stew that mostly looks after itself once it's simmering.
steps: Fry the onion and carrots in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the paprika, tomatoes, and butter beans, adding a splash of stock if it looks dry.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until the carrots are tender and the stew has thickened. Serve with bread or mash.

title: One-Pot Chicken & Chickpea Stew
teaser: A simple, warming stew that leans on tinned chickpeas and tomatoes.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in the paprika, tomatoes, and chickpeas, adding a splash of stock if it looks dry.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the stew has thickened. Serve with bread or rice.

title: Creamy Beef Mince Stroganoff
teaser: A quicker mince twist on stroganoff, finished with a paprika soured cream sauce.
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in a little oil for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the paprika and beef stock and simmer for 8-10 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the soured cream.
Serve over rice or pasta.

title: Moroccan Lamb & Apricot Stew
teaser: Lamb mince simmered with dried apricots and warm spices for a sweet-savoury weeknight stew.

ingredients.item: Lamb or vegetable stock as needed

steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Add the lamb mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the cumin and cinnamon, then add the tomatoes and apricots, with a splash of stock if it looks dry.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until thickened. Serve with couscous or flatbread.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
teaser: A creamy, mildly spiced curry using shop-bought tikka paste to keep things fast.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4-5 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in the curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 12-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the cream, warm through, and serve with rice.

title: Chicken Katsu Curry
teaser: Crispy breaded chicken with a mild, slightly sweet Japanese-style curry sauce.
steps: Coat the chicken in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, and fry in oil for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Slice.
Meanwhile, soften the onion in a little oil for 4 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the stock, then simmer for 8-10 minutes until thickened. Stir in the honey.
Serve the sliced chicken over rice with the curry sauce poured over.

title: Mince Keema Curry
teaser: A spiced mince curry that's quicker to make than most curries since there's no meat to cut up.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 12-15 minutes.
Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes of cooking, and serve with rice.

title: Salmon & Spinach Curry
teaser: A milder, quicker curry that keeps the salmon in large flakes rather than breaking it up.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the salmon cubes and cook gently for 4-5 minutes until just cooked through.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, and serve over rice.

title: Thai Green Chicken Curry
teaser: A fragrant, coconut-based curry that comes together fast using shop-bought green curry paste.

ingredients.item: Handful Thai basil or regular basil

steps: Fry the curry paste in a little oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes until lightly coloured.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pepper and fish sauce, and simmer for a further 5 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the basil and serve with rice.

title: Coconut Chickpea Curry
teaser: A vegetarian curry that's mostly tinned and store-cupboard ingredients.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and coconut milk, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and simmer for a further 8-10 minutes until thickened.
Season to taste and serve with rice.

title: Butternut Squash & Chickpea Curry
teaser: A vegetarian curry built on soft roasted squash and chickpeas simmered in coconut milk.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic, and ginger in a little oil for 4-5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the squash and coconut milk, and simmer for 15-18 minutes until the squash is tender.
Stir in the chickpeas and simmer for a further 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice.

title: Salmon Teriyaki Noodles
teaser: Pan-fried salmon and noodles tossed in a sticky homemade teriyaki sauce.

ingredients.item: Spring onion and sesame seeds to garnish

steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions and drain.
Season the salmon and pan-fry skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip and cook for 2-3 minutes more. Flake into chunks.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and garlic together in the pan and simmer for 1-2 minutes until slightly sticky.
Toss the noodles through the sauce, then fold in the salmon.
Drizzle with sesame oil and top with spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry
teaser: Chicken and vegetables stir-fried with noodles in a simple soy sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions, drain, and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok until cooked through, then set aside.
Add the pepper and carrot and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic, then return the chicken and noodles to the pan with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes and serve.

title: Sticky Sesame Chicken Noodles
teaser: Chicken and egg noodles tossed in a sticky sesame-soy glaze.
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions, drain, and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in a little vegetable oil over high heat until cooked through and lightly browned.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil, and simmer for 1-2 minutes until sticky.
Toss the noodles through the chicken and sauce, and top with sesame seeds.

title: Spicy Peanut Chicken Noodles
teaser: Noodles and chicken tossed in a quick peanut butter and chilli sauce.

ingredients.item: Splash of hot water to loosen

steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions, drain, and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in a little oil until cooked through and lightly browned.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chilli flakes, and garlic together, adding hot water until pourable.
Toss the noodles and sauce through the chicken in the pan.
Serve immediately, with extra chilli flakes if you like it hotter.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Noodles
teaser: Shrimp and noodles tossed in a quick garlic butter sauce — simple and fast.
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions and drain.
Melt the butter in a pan and fry the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Stir in the soy sauce and lemon juice, then toss the noodles through.
Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Beef Mince Cottage Pie
teaser: A comforting mince and mashed potato bake that's mostly hands-off in the oven.
steps: Boil the potatoes until soft, about 15 minutes, then drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Meanwhile, fry the onion and carrots in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C). Spoon the mince into an ovenproof dish, top with the mash, and scatter with cheese if using.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden on top.

title: Beef Mince Stuffed Peppers
teaser: Bell peppers filled with a savoury mince and rice mixture, baked until tender.
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (fan 170°C).
Fry the onion and mince until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the rice, half the tomatoes, and the oregano.
Spoon the mixture into the peppers and place in an ovenproof dish. Pour the remaining tomatoes around them.
Top with cheese and bake for 25-30 minutes until the peppers are tender.

title: Mince & Onion Pasta Bake
teaser: A baked pasta dish with a rich mince sauce and melted cheese on top.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Cook the pasta until just tender and drain.
Fry the onion and mince until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomatoes and herbs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix the pasta through the sauce, transfer to an ovenproof dish, top with cheese, and bake for 15-20 minutes until golden.

title: Chicken Parmesan Bake
teaser: Breaded chicken baked under tomato sauce and melted cheese.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
Dip the chicken in the egg, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in a little oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden (it doesn't need to be fully cooked through yet).
Place in an ovenproof dish, spoon over the tomatoes and oregano, and top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is bubbling.

title: Lamb Mince Shepherd's Pie
teaser: The classic mashed-potato-topped bake, made with lamb mince for a slightly richer flavour.
steps: Boil the potatoes until soft, about 15 minutes, then drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Fry the onion and carrots in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lamb mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomato purée and stock and simmer for 12-15 minutes until thickened.
Preheat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C). Spoon the mince into an ovenproof dish, top with the mash, and bake for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Beef Mince Lasagne
teaser: A weeknight-sized lasagne — not quick, but mostly hands-off once it's in the oven.

ingredients.item: cheese sauce (from a jar, or butter, flour, and milk with cheddar stirred through)

steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (fan 170°C).
Fry the onion and mince until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 10 minutes.
In an ovenproof dish, layer mince sauce, lasagne sheets, and cheese sauce, repeating until you run out, finishing with cheese sauce on top.
Scatter with the grated cheddar and bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and the pasta is tender.

title: Salmon Fishcakes
teaser: Homemade fishcakes using tinned or cooked salmon and mashed potato.
steps: Mix the mashed potato, salmon, and spring onions together, and season well.
Shape into 4-6 patties.
Dip each patty in the beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in a little oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and heated through.
